residence.summary: A full relocation or extended part-year stay can create Spanish tax residence.
non_day_tests: Main centre or base of economic activities or interests
Rebuttable spouse and dependent-minor family presumption

funding_source_notes.portfolio: Resident taxation can reach worldwide dividends, interest and realized gains.
funding_source_notes.pension: Pension treatment depends on pension type, source country and any applicable treaty.
funding_source_notes.property: Spanish property can create income, wealth and disposal exposure even while nonresident.
funding_source_notes.work_business: Work and business income require residence, source and social-tax review.
funding_source_notes.mixed: Mixed-income FIRE plans require category-by-category treatment.

tax_screen.planning_band_method: Product-defined stress-test allowances applied to modeled dependable income and portfolio withdrawals. They are deliberately broad scenarios, not sourced statutory rates, tax estimates, or assessments.

purchase.summary: Purchase taxes vary by region, property type and whether the sale is new or resale.

annual.summary: Local property tax and possible wealth or imputed-income exposure require property and residence facts.

rental.summary: Rental income remains taxable and deductions can depend on residence and treaty context.

sale.summary: Capital-gains tax and nonresident sale withholding can apply.

succession.summary: Inheritance and gift exposure depends on residence, location, relationship and regional rules.
